purpose: Separate distinct post-rehydration observables that had previously been compressed into a single recovery or proliferation clock.

privacy_boundary.trigger: A private domain-expert correspondence triggered the re-audit.
privacy_boundary.rule: No unpublished observation from the private correspondence is reproduced, quantified, attributed, or promoted in this public artifact without explicit permission.

clock_map.public_observation: Larvae resume active life in approximately one hour after rehydration.
clock_map.interpretation: Behavioral or organismal function can return rapidly.

clock_map.public_observation: Oxidative stress is strongest during the first hour after rehydration; oxidative damage to DNA and membrane lipids is reported to be repaired within a few hours.
clock_map.interpretation: Some oxidative lesions resolve on an hours-scale clock.

clock_map.public_observation: Alkaline comet-assay fragmentation after anhydrobiosis showed no significant recovery within the first 24 h and returned to background by approximately 96 h.
clock_map.interpretation: The fragmentation/integrity endpoint has a much slower clock in the assayed fat-body-cell population.

clock_map.public_observation: Functional outputs can be detectable early after rehydration; preserved receptor/co-receptor function can be detected at approximately 1 h in some assays, while de-novo-protein-dependent ligand response is restored from approximately 12-24 h.
clock_map.interpretation: Cellular function and proteostatic rebuilding are active before detectable bulk population expansion.

clock_map.public_observation: Live-cell concentration was stable from the 1 h baseline through 48 h; statistically significant population growth was first detected at 72 h and plateaued near 144 h in the published 2025 series.
clock_map.interpretation: Bulk population expansion is delayed relative to several early functional-recovery readouts.

clock_map.public_observation: No sufficiently dense public matched EdU/BrdU/flow-cytometric/mitotic-index time series was identified that establishes the first post-rehydration S-phase or first mitosis across 0-96 h.
clock_map.interpretation: First cell-cycle entry remains a missing measurement and must not be inferred from bulk cell-count significance.

damage_metric_calibration.reason: Different assays observe different lesion classes and biological compartments. Hours-scale oxidative-damage resolution and approximately 96 h fat-body comet-fragmentation recovery must not be averaged or treated as the same state variable.

causal_separation_anchor.public_result: Hsf knockdown reduced Pv11 survival after rehydration approximately fivefold, while the post-day-1 proliferation rate comparison was not significantly altered (reported ANOVA P=0.3).
causal_separation_anchor.interpretation: Desiccation-survival capacity and the later proliferation rate of surviving cells are experimentally separable observables.
